attributes.board_name: Indiana State Board of Nursing (Professional Licensing Agency)

rules.notes: Indiana has no CE requirement to renew RN or LPN licenses. All licenses of this type expire Oct 31 of odd years regardless of issue date; renewal opens no later than 90 days before expiry.
